mapper.select: SELECT w.ware_id AS wareId, concat(w.warehouse_pos_x,w.warehouse_pos_y) AS wareCoord, wa.ware_address AS wareAddress, wa.ware_admin_number AS adminNumber, userware.client_id AS clientID, user.user_name AS clientName, user.business_number AS clientBusinessNumber, userware.ware_start_date AS startDate, userware.ware_end_date AS endDate, MAX(i.last_inbound_date) AS lastInboundDate, MAX(i.last_outbound_date) AS lastOutboundDate FROM wareHouse w JOIN warehouse_area wa on w.ware_id = wa.ware_id JOIN userWareHouse userware ON w.ware_id = userware.ware_id and w.warehouse_pos_x = userware.warehouse_pos_x and w.warehouse_pos_y = userware.warehouse_pos_y JOIN user ON userware.client_id = user.client_id JOIN inventory i ON userware.client_id = i.client_id GROUP BY w.ware_id,wareCoord;

SELECT ware.ware_id AS wareId, ware.ware_name AS wareName, ware.ware_address as wareAddress, admin.admin_name as wareAdminName, ware.ware_total_size as wareTotalSize, ware.available_space as wareAvailSpace, MAX(i.last_inbound_date) as lastInboundDate, MAX(i.last_outbound_date) as lastOutboundDate FROM warehouse_area ware JOIN inventory i ON ware.ware_id = i.ware_id JOIN admin ON ware.ware_admin_number = admin.admin_number group by i.ware_id;
